CJP the Panda (@mrtimer2022)

There are a lot of reasons I bought my Cybertruck. But I had no idea at the time that my 83 yr old dad would come to live w/ us nor that I’d be driving him 6x a week to activities, medical appts, etc. His walker is heavy & bulky but effortlessly goes into tailgate in seconds. Tonneau protects it. Truck lowers so he can climb in… which with Parkinson’s is a huge help. And FSD gives us a maximum safe, comfortable ride. It turns out my dad was in hindsight the best reason to buy Cybertruck! ❤️

NEWS: Grok Bot handled a 175% surge in support tickets without new hires.

* Resolved 99% of refund requests autonomously at $0.20–$0.30 per ticket.
* Trained on 1M+ customer interactions.
* Analyzes 20,000+ daily feedback items for engineering insights.
* Could potentially eliminate the need for 200 additional support roles.

AI agents are moving deeper into real-world business operations.

Elon Musk: Now we’re going to look at the computer for the Cybercab. The computer will be somewhat overspecified, but I think there’s a major opportunity here.

Similar to Amazon Web Services, if the car is driving for 50 hours a week, that leaves more than 100 hours where the compute is sitting there unused.

You could use that idle compute for distributed inference.

If you have a fleet of 100 million vehicles, each with roughly a kilowatt of efficient inference compute, that’s about 100 GW of compute. That’s a massive amount of compute. And if it’s already there, you might as well use it.

I think that makes a lot of sense. The autonomous future is here.

BREAKING: Tesla has officially reached 100,000 vehicles on the road in Denmark. 🇩🇰⚡️

Tesla’s Danish fleet has doubled from 50,000 to 100,000 in less than three years.

• ~4,000 vehicles in 2018
• 50,000+ in September 2023
• 100,000 in September 2026
• Tesla registrations surged 144% YoY in March and 104% in August

A major milestone for Tesla in one of Europe’s strongest EV markets. 🚗🔋
